skill.summary: Manage SoftSync workspace members, roles, settings, and add-ons through documented API tool workflows.

content.user_title: Manage SoftSync Workspace Members and Add-ons
content.value_statement: Workspace administration affects team access, shared settings, and paid seats. This skill guides SoftSync tool workflows for member management, settings updates, and add-on changes.
actual_capabilities: Guides listing workspace members and their Admin, Editor, or Viewer roles.
Guides inviting members by email after confirming their address and role.
Describes role changes and member removal, including last-admin protection and record retention.
Guides updating workspace name, country, currency, or language using only changed fields.
Guides listing add-ons and previewing additions or field conflicts before installation.
Describes installing, updating, and uninstalling add-ons with workspace-wide effects and retained records.
limitations: Provides instructions only; it does not include the SoftSync tool implementation or connection setup.
Requires access to the documented SoftSync tools and the Admin role for administrative workflows.
Invitations use paid seats and send real emails; changes affect the whole workspace.
Documents backend protections but does not independently implement or verify their enforcement.

use_cases.title: Onboard a teammate
use_cases.description: Confirm an email address and role, explain the paid seat impact, and invite a new workspace member.

use_cases.title: Update shared workspace settings
use_cases.description: Review requested changes to the workspace name, country, currency, or language, then update only those fields.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a service desk add-on
use_cases.description: List available add-ons, preview proposed additions and field conflicts, and review the workspace-wide impact before installation.

prompt_templates.title: List workspace members
prompt_templates.prompt: List the current workspace members and their roles. Do not change memberships or settings.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a member invitation
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an invitation for [email] as [role]. Explain the paid seat impact and confirm the address and role before inviting.

prompt_templates.title: Update selected settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Change the workspace name to [name] and language to [language]. Explain the team-wide impact first, then send only those changed fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: make a targeted settings change

prompt_templates.title: Review an add-on rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: List add-ons and preview [add-on]. Report proposed additions, field conflicts, and workspace-wide impact. Wait for approval before installing or updating.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: assess a shared add-on change

output_examples.output: This invitation will email jordan@example.com and use a paid seat. Please confirm the address and Editor role before I send it.

output_examples.input: What happens if I uninstall an add-on?
output_examples.output: Uninstalling hides the add-on's groups from everyone in the workspace. Records remain, and reinstalling restores the groups.

output_examples.input: Change the workspace currency to EUR.
output_examples.output: This change affects the whole workspace. The update will include only the currency field, leaving the name, country, and language unchanged.

best_practices: Verify Admin access and explain the workspace-wide impact before making changes.
Confirm the invitation email address and role before using a paid seat.
Show add-on previews and field conflicts before installation; send only changed fields for settings updates.
anti_patterns: Sending invitations without confirming the recipient, role, and paid seat impact.
Installing or updating add-ons without showing the preview and explaining shared effects.
Treating member removal or add-on uninstallation as record deletion.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Administrative actions require access to the documented SoftSync tools.

faq.question: Who can manage the workspace?
faq.answer: The skill requires the Admin role for people, settings, and add-ons. It also documents that non-admin members can remove only themselves.

faq.question: Does inviting someone have a cost?
faq.answer: An invitation uses a paid seat and sends an email. Confirm the address and role first.

faq.question: Can the last admin change their role?
faq.answer: The skill states that the last admin cannot step down.

faq.question: Does removing a member delete their records?
faq.answer: No. Removal takes the member out of the workspace and its groups, but their records remain.

faq.question: What happens when an add-on is uninstalled?
faq.answer: Its groups are hidden from everyone, but records remain. Installing the add-on again brings the groups back.
